lines.japanese: これは “たとえば” の話だけど
lines.english: Suppose, just for a moment…

lines.japanese: ある日、翼あるひとびとが
lines.english: One day, a people with wings

lines.japanese: グレタガルドの白い空を埋めつくしたんだ
lines.english: filled every inch of Gretagard’s white sky.

lines.japanese: 天地の半ばに羽根の舞う
lines.english: Between earth and sky, feathers whirled,

lines.japanese: 雪花のごとく繽紛と
lines.english: thick as falling snow.

lines.japanese: 慈悲なき鏃の降りそそぐ
lines.english: Pitiless arrowheads rained down

lines.japanese: 羽根のまにまに繽紛と
lines.english: in flurries with the feathers.

lines.japanese: 燃える礫の降りそそぐ
lines.english: Burning stones rained down

lines.japanese: 羽根のまにまに繽紛と
lines.english: in flurries with the feathers.

lines.japanese: 草葺き屋根の里が焼け
lines.english: Thatched villages burned;

lines.japanese: ポプラ木立の邑が焼け
lines.english: towns among the poplars burned.

lines.japanese: 世界の底を逃げまどう
lines.english: Across the floor of the world,

lines.japanese: 無辜なる民の靴の音
lines.english: the footfalls of innocents in flight.

lines.japanese: 石の街路を駆けぬけて
lines.english: Down streets of stone,

lines.japanese: 荒れた蹊を駆けぬけて
lines.english: down rough and broken paths—

lines.japanese: 世界の底を逃げまどう
lines.english: across the floor of the world,

lines.japanese: 馬のひづめの轟きよ
lines.english: the thunder of fleeing hooves.

lines.japanese: エルフの森の王国も
lines.english: The elves’ forest kingdom,

lines.japanese: ドワーフ造りの山の砦も
lines.english: the mountain fortresses built by dwarves,

lines.japanese: 機械仕掛けのノームの城も
lines.english: the gnomes’ clockwork castles—

lines.japanese: 猖獗極まる侵寇の
lines.english: all swallowed by the raging tide of invasion,

lines.japanese: 波濤に呑まれて隊伍散る
lines.english: their ranks scattered.

lines.japanese: 戦火の汀に立たされた
lines.english: Driven to the shores of war,

lines.japanese: 人の子たちの負け戦
lines.english: the children of men fought a losing battle.

lines.japanese: 翼の泊る空の下
lines.english: Beneath a sky where wings came to rest,

lines.japanese: 堅牢堅固も過去の栄誉か
lines.english: was all their strength now a glory of the past?

lines.japanese: 終焉迫る城塞都市
lines.english: The fortress city’s end drew near.

lines.japanese: 聖なる騎士さえ堂に入り　円蓋の下　神よと祈った
lines.english:
Even the holy knight entered the sanctuary
and prayed beneath its dome: O God.

lines.japanese: 宮廷道化は楼閣のぼり　蝉の翼で飛ばんと嘯く
lines.english:
The court jester climbed a tower, boasting
he would fly on a cicada’s wings.

lines.japanese: 陰に潜んだスラムの王は　武具を鎧って空を睨んだ
lines.english:
The king of the slums lurked in shadow,
armed and armored, glaring at the sky.

lines.japanese: 暗き洞棲む妖術使いは　闇を纏って機を待った
lines.english:
The sorcerer in his dark cave
cloaked himself in darkness and awaited his chance.

lines.japanese: ほら、空ってどこにでも繋がってるよね
lines.english: You see, the sky leads everywhere.

lines.japanese: どこへ逃げたって、
lines.english: Wherever they fled,

lines.japanese: 敵はその白い翼でどこまでも追っかけてくるんだ
lines.english: the enemy would follow on those white wings.

lines.japanese: だから翼のない彼らは、
lines.english: So those without wings

lines.japanese: どこにも繋がってない空を求めていた
lines.english: longed for a sky that led nowhere.

lines.japanese: そんな願いが通じて、
lines.english: Their wish was heard.

lines.japanese: いま彼らはとてものどかな国でジングルベルを聴いていた
lines.english: Now, in a very peaceful land, they were listening to “Jingle Bells.”

lines.japanese: これは “たとえば” の話だけど
lines.english: Suppose, just for a moment…

lines.japanese: 僕らが君に語るのは、たとえばそんなメルヘン
lines.english: The fairy tale we have for you is something like that.
